ParticleMCC Object

The ParticleMCC object defines all the settings to control the Monte Carlo Collision models. These can be used within the particle solvers: TRK, Es-PIC and PIC.

  • General Methods

  • Background Gas

  • Collision

  • Examples

General Methods

Reset

Delete all defined background gases and collisions.

 

EnableAcceleration ( bool flag )

Enables or disables the OpenMP acceleration of the particle collision routines.

Background Gas

SetGasName( string name )

Set the name of a background gas.

 

SetGasMass (  double mass )

This method sets the mass of a background gas particle in atomic units.

 

SetGasPressure (  double pressure )

This method sets the pressure of the background gas. The pressure is defined in Torr.

 

SetGasTemperature (  double temperature )

This method sets the temperature of the background gas. The temperature is defined in Kelvin.

 

AddGas

Add a gas entry to the MCC model with the all of the above defined values.

Collision

IsActive( bool flag )

Enables or disables the following defined collision.

 

SetIncidentSpecies ( string particle species name )

Set the name of the incident species. A particle source with such a species has to be active within the simulation.

 

SetTargetedSpecies ( string background gas name )

Set the name of the targeted species. A background gas with this name has to be defined.

 

SetCollisionType ( string collision type )

Select the collision type of the defined collision. Valid types are "ionization","excitation", "elastic" and "ion-elastic".

 

SetParameter (  double parameter )

This method sets the parameter of the defined collision. The ionization model requires this parameter for setting the electron shape parameter.

 

SetCoulombScattering ( bool flag )

Switches between a Coulomb or isotropic scattering model.

 

SetCrossSectionFileName ( string fileame )

This method can be used to set the name of the file which is used to import the cross-section data. To import the data, the method CrossSectionImportDataPair must be used.

 

CrossSectionImportDataPair ( double dEnergy, double dCrossSection )

This method sets the collision cross section at a given energy. This is equivalent to importing one data pair of the energy - cross section curve.

 

AddCollision

Add a collision entry to the MCC model with the all of the above defined values.

Particle Monte Carlo Collision Examples

' Particle Monte Carlo Collision definition of one background gas and one collision

With ParticleMCC

     .Reset

     .EnableAcceleration "False"

     .SetGasName "He"

     .SetGasMass "4"

     .SetGasPressure "0.01"

     .SetGasTemperature "300"

     .AddGas

     .IsActive "True"

     .SetIncidentSpecies "electron"

     .SetTargetedSpecies "He"

     .SetCollisionType "excitation"

     .SetParameter ""

     .SetCoulombScattering "True"

     .SetCrossSectionFileName "crosssection.txt"

     .CrossSectionImportDataPair "2.000e+01", "2.00e-20"

     .CrossSectionImportDataPair "2.200e+01", "2.00e-20"

     .AddCollision

End With
